items.title: 1M context is now generally available for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6
items.title_zh: Opus 4.6 与 Sonnet 4.6 正式开放 100 万 token 上下文
items.summary: A 1M-token context window is now generally available for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 at standard pricing across the full window, with no long-context premium. Media limits also expand to 600 images or PDF pages.

items.title: Designing AI agents to resist prompt injection
items.title_zh: 设计能抵御提示注入的 AI 智能体
items.summary: OpenAI describes how ChatGPT defends against prompt injection and social engineering by constraining risky actions and protecting sensitive data in agent workflows.

items.title: Beyond Explicit Edges: Robust Reasoning over Noisy and Sparse Knowledge Graphs
items.title_zh: 超越显式边：在噪声与稀疏知识图谱上的鲁棒推理
items.summary: INSES is a dynamic GraphRAG framework that couples LLM-guided navigation, which prunes noise and steers exploration, with embedding-based similarity expansion to recover hidden links in noisy or sparse knowledge graphs. A lightweight router sends simple queries to naive RAG and escalates complex ones to INSES, and the system performs favorably against RAG and GraphRAG baselines, notably on the MINE benchmark.

items.title: Arbiter: Detecting Interference in LLM Agent System Prompts
items.title_zh: Arbiter：检测 LLM 智能体系统提示中的干扰
items.summary: Arbiter combines formal evaluation rules with multi-model LLM scouring to detect interference patterns in the system prompts of Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI. It reports 152 findings in undirected scouring and 21 hand-labeled interference patterns for one vendor, including a Gemini CLI memory-system data-loss finding consistent with an issue Google filed and patched.

items.title: Distilling Reasoning Without Knowledge: A Framework for Reliable LLMs
items.title_zh: 不蒸馏知识而蒸馏推理：面向可靠 LLM 的框架
items.summary: The framework separates planning from factual retrieval and answer synthesis, training a lightweight student planner with teacher-generated structured decompositions and searchable fact requests but no factual answers. On the SEAL-0 benchmark, supervised planning improves both accuracy and latency relative to monolithic reasoning models and prompt-based tool-augmented systems.

items.title: Agentic Critical Training
items.title_zh: Agentic Critical Training：通过行动判别训练智能体
items.summary: Agentic Critical Training uses reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards to teach models to judge actions, pairing an expert action with an alternative sampled from the initial policy and rewarding only selection of the expert action. On ALFWorld-ID, WebShop, and ScienceWorld it yields average gains of 5.85 points over imitation learning and 4.12 points over imitation learning followed by RL.

items.title: MEMO: Memory-Augmented Model Context Optimization for Robust Multi-Turn Multi-Agent LLM Games
items.title_zh: MEMO：面向稳健多轮多智能体 LLM 游戏的记忆增强上下文优化
items.summary: MEMO is a self-play framework that optimizes inference-time context through a persistent memory bank and tournament-style prompt evolution with uncertainty-aware selection. Across five text-based games, it raised GPT-4o-mini's mean win rate from 25.1% to 49.5% and reduced run-to-run variance.

items.title: The ARC of Progress towards AGI: A Living Survey of Abstraction and Reasoning
items.title_zh: 通往 AGI 的 ARC 之路：抽象与推理的持续更新综述
items.summary: This living survey presents the first cross-generation analysis of 82 approaches across three ARC-AGI benchmark versions, finding consistent 2-3x performance drops from ARC-AGI-1 to ARC-AGI-2 across program-synthesis, neuro-symbolic, and neural paradigms. It reports top scores of 93.0% on ARC-AGI-1, 68.8% on ARC-AGI-2, and 13% on ARC-AGI-3, while humans remain near-perfect.

items.title: Reason and Verify: A Framework for Faithful Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: Reason and Verify：面向忠实检索增强生成的框架
items.summary: The framework adds neural query rewriting, BGE cross-encoder reranking, and rationale generation that grounds sub-claims in evidence spans, plus an eight-category taxonomy for assessing rationale faithfulness. With Llama-3-8B-Instruct it reaches 89.1% on BioASQ-Y/N and 73.0% on PubMedQA, competitive with systems using much larger models.

items.title: COMPASS: The explainable agentic framework for Sovereignty, Sustainability, Compliance, and Ethics
items.title_zh: COMPASS：面向主权、可持续性、合规与伦理的可解释智能体框架
items.summary: COMPASS is a multi-agent orchestration framework with an orchestrator and four specialized sub-agents for sovereignty, carbon-aware computing, compliance, and ethics, each using RAG to ground evaluations in verified documents. An LLM-as-judge assigns quantitative scores and explainable justifications, and automated evaluation indicates that RAG integration improves semantic coherence and mitigates hallucination risk.

items.title: Mind the Sim2Real Gap in User Simulation for Agentic Tasks
items.title_zh: 警惕智能体任务中用户模拟的 Sim2Real 差距
items.summary: The authors run the full τ-bench protocol with 451 real participants across 165 tasks and benchmark 31 LLM simulators using a new User-Sim Index. They find simulators are excessively cooperative, stylistically uniform, and lacking realistic frustration, creating an "easy mode" that inflates agent success rates above the human baseline.

items.title: Multi-Step Semantic Reasoning in Generative Retrieval
items.title_zh: 生成式检索中的多步语义推理
items.summary: ReasonGR enhances multi-step semantic reasoning in generative retrieval for numerical contexts by combining task-specific instructions with stepwise reasoning guidance and a reasoning-focused adaptation module. Experiments on FinQA show improved retrieval accuracy and consistency for complex financial queries.

items.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Reference Extraction and Parsing in the Social Sciences and Humanities
items.title_zh: 大语言模型在社会科学与人文领域的参考文献抽取与解析基准
items.summary: The paper introduces a unified benchmark for reference extraction and parsing on social-science and humanities corpora, comparing GROBID with DeepSeek-V3.1, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B, Gemma-3-27B-it and Qwen3-VL. Extraction largely saturates past a moderate capability threshold, parsing remains the bottleneck, and lightweight LoRA adaptation gives consistent gains.

items.title: ESG-Bench: Benchmarking Long-Context ESG Reports for Hallucination Mitigation
items.title_zh: ESG-Bench：面向幻觉缓解的长上下文 ESG 报告基准
items.summary: ESG-Bench provides human-annotated QA pairs grounded in real ESG report contexts, with fine-grained labels marking whether model outputs are factually supported or hallucinated. Chain-of-thought prompting and fine-tuning on CoT rationales substantially reduce hallucinations, and the authors report that the gains transfer to QA benchmarks beyond ESG.

items.title: StatePlane: A Cognitive State Plane for Long-Horizon AI Systems Under Bounded Context
items.title_zh: StatePlane：面向有限上下文长时程 AI 系统的认知状态平面
items.summary: StatePlane is a model-agnostic cognitive state plane that governs the formation, evolution, retrieval and decay of episodic, semantic and procedural state for AI systems operating under bounded context. It argues that long-horizon intelligence can be achieved without expanding context windows or retraining models.

items.title: The Reasoning Bottleneck in Graph-RAG: Structured Prompting and Context Compression for Multi-Hop QA
items.title_zh: Graph-RAG 中的推理瓶颈：面向多跳问答的结构化提示与上下文压缩
items.summary: Evaluating KET-RAG on three multi-hop QA benchmarks, the authors find that 77% to 91% of questions have the gold answer in the retrieved context yet accuracy is only 35% to 78%, with 73% to 84% of errors traced to reasoning failures. SPARQL chain-of-thought prompting and graph-walk compression improve accuracy, and with question-type routing an augmented Llama-8B matches or exceeds an unaugmented Llama-70B at roughly 12x lower cost.

items.title: D-MEM: Dopamine-Gated Agentic Memory via Reward Prediction Error Routing
items.title_zh: D-MEM：通过奖励预测误差路由的多巴胺门控智能体记忆
items.summary: D-MEM decouples short-term interaction from cognitive restructuring with a fast/slow router driven by reward prediction error: a lightweight critic scores surprise and utility, caching routine inputs in an O(1) buffer and triggering an O(N) memory-evolution pipeline for contradictions or preference shifts. The authors introduce the LoCoMo-Noise benchmark and report over 80% lower token consumption, removal of O(N^2) write-latency, and better multi-hop and adversarial performance.

items.title: GenState-AI: State-Aware Dataset for Text-to-Video Retrieval on AI-Generated Videos
items.title_zh: GenState-AI：面向 AI 生成视频的文本到视频检索状态感知数据集
items.summary: GenState-AI is a benchmark of 956 AI-generated videos and 195 verified state-change queries across Toy, Cartoon, Home and Manipulation domains, designed so retrieval cannot be solved from static appearance alone. Qwen3-VL (8B) achieves the best macro-average Recall@1 and triplet consistency, but stronger retrieval does not consistently yield correct hard-negative ordering.

items.title: When Scanners Lie: Evaluator Instability in LLM Red-Teaming
items.title_zh: 当扫描器说谎：LLM 红队测试中的评估器不稳定性
items.summary: The study finds that open-source LLM vulnerability scanners produce attack-success rates that shift with the evaluator, with 22 of 25 Garak attack categories showing instability and reported scores varying by up to 33%. It proposes a two-phase, reliability-aware evaluation framework that raises evaluator accuracy from 72% to 89%.

items.title: Learning When to Sample: Confidence-Aware Selective Sampling for Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
items.title_zh: 学会何时采样：面向高效思维链推理的置信度感知选择性采样
items.summary: The framework analyzes a single chain-of-thought trajectory at inference time to decide whether to rely on it or trigger multi-path sampling. Trained on MedQA and transferred to MathQA, MedMCQA, and MMLU, it cut token usage by 71.7% versus full multi-path reasoning while accuracy changed by -0.41 percentage points.

items.title: Design and evaluation of an agentic workflow for crisis-related synthetic tweet datasets
items.title_zh: 面向危机相关合成推文数据集的 agent 工作流设计与评估
items.summary: The paper presents an agentic workflow that iteratively generates synthetic crisis tweets conditioned on target characteristics, checks them against compliance rules and refines them with structured feedback. A post-earthquake damage-assessment case study indicates the synthetic data can support geolocalization and damage-level prediction.

items.title: Clinician input steers AI toward accurate and harmful recommendations
items.title_zh: 临床医生的输入会引导 AI 给出准确但也有害的建议
items.summary: Using 61 NEJM Case Records and 21 reasoning variants from eight models, the study finds that clinician context raises LLM-clinician concordance and improves correct final-diagnosis inclusion by a mean 20.4 points, while adversarial context degrades performance in 14 models. Inference-time scaling reduces harmful echoing of clinician-introduced recommendations across WHO harm-severity tiers.

items.title: RenderMem: Rendering as Spatial Memory Retrieval
items.title_zh: RenderMem：将渲染作为空间记忆检索
items.summary: RenderMem is a spatial-memory framework for embodied agents that maintains a 3D scene representation and renders query-conditioned views as visual evidence, enabling reasoning about line-of-sight, visibility and occlusion from arbitrary viewpoints. Experiments in AI2-THOR show gains on viewpoint-dependent visibility and occlusion queries over prior memory baselines.

items.title: fabio-rovai/open-ontologies
items.title_zh: open-ontologies：面向生产本体的变更管理工具
items.summary: Open-ontologies is a Rust tool for planning, applying, and rolling back changes to a production ontology, with a blast-radius report and a proof that an auditor can re-check.

items.title: wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-sleep
items.title_zh: ARIS：睡眠中自动开展机器学习研究的技能集
items.summary: ARIS is a set of lightweight, Markdown-only skills for autonomous ML research, covering cross-model review loops, idea discovery, and experiment automation, and works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, or any LLM agent.

items.title: BuilderIO/agent-native
items.title_zh: agent-native：构建智能体应用的 TypeScript 框架
items.summary: agent-native is a TypeScript framework for building agentic applications.

items.title: pasky/chrome-cdp-skill
items.title_zh: pasky/chrome-cdp-skill：让 AI agent 接入实时 Chrome 会话
items.summary: A JavaScript skill that gives an AI agent access to a live Chrome session, connecting out of the box to tabs the user already has open.

items.title: jackwener/OpenCLI
items.title_zh: OpenCLI：把任意网站变成 CLI
items.summary: OpenCLI is a JavaScript project that turns any website into a command-line interface and lets an AI agent use the browser session the user is already logged into.

items.title: nikmcfly/MiroFish-Offline
items.title_zh: MiroFish-Offline：离线多智能体模拟引擎
items.summary: An English fork of MiroFish that provides an offline multi-agent simulation and prediction engine built on a local Neo4j graph database and Ollama stack.

items.title: Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything
items.title_zh: Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything——把代码变成可交互知识图谱
items.summary: A TypeScript tool that turns code into an interactive knowledge graph for exploration, search and question answering, and works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and other coding agents.

items.title: 1M context is now generally available for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6
items.title_zh: Opus 4.6 与 Sonnet 4.6 正式开放 100 万 token 上下文
items.summary: A 1M-token context window is now generally available for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 at standard pricing across the full window, with no long-context premium. Media limits also expand to 600 images or PDF pages.

items.title: Designing AI agents to resist prompt injection
items.title_zh: 设计能抵御提示注入的 AI 智能体
items.summary: OpenAI describes how ChatGPT defends against prompt injection and social engineering by constraining risky actions and protecting sensitive data in agent workflows.

items.title: Improving instruction hierarchy in frontier LLMs
items.title_zh: 改进前沿 LLM 中的指令层级
items.summary: OpenAI describes IH-Challenge, which trains models to prioritize trusted instructions, improving instruction hierarchy, safety steerability, and resistance to prompt injection attacks.

items.title: Levels of Agentic Engineering
items.title_zh: 智能体工程的层级
items.summary: The post argues that AI coding ability is outpacing practitioners' ability to use it effectively and outlines eight levels of agentic engineering, from tab completion to autonomous agent teams.

items.title: From model to agent: Equipping the Responses API with a computer environment
items.title_zh: 从模型到智能体：为 Responses API 配备计算机环境
items.summary: OpenAI explains how it built an agent runtime using the Responses API, shell tool, and hosted containers to run secure, scalable agents with files, tools, and state.

items.title: How we hacked McKinsey's AI platform
items.title_zh: 我们如何攻破麦肯锡的 AI 平台
items.summary: The post describes how an autonomous AI agent found a SQL injection vulnerability in McKinsey's Lilli AI platform, and says the data it extracted was worse than expected.

items.title: Identifying Interactions at Scale for LLMs
items.title_zh: 大规模识别 LLM 中的交互作用
items.summary: A BAIR blog post surveys feature attribution, data attribution and mechanistic interpretability as lenses for understanding LLM behavior, arguing that the core difficulty is complexity at scale because behavior emerges from many interacting components rather than isolated parts.

items.title: Kotlin creator's new language: talk to LLMs in specs, not English
items.title_zh: Kotlin 之父的新语言：用规格而非英语与 LLM 对话
items.summary: CodeSpeak is described as an agentic engineering toolkit that lets developers write programs in structured human language.

items.title: OpenAI to acquire Promptfoo
items.title_zh: OpenAI 将收购 Promptfoo
items.summary: OpenAI is acquiring Promptfoo, an AI security platform that helps enterprises identify and remediate vulnerabilities in AI systems during development.

items.title: China cyber emergency center flags security risks in AI agent OpenClaw
items.title_zh: 中国国家网络安全应急中心提示 OpenClaw 安全风险
items.summary: China's National Computer Network Emergency Response Technical Team/Coordination Center issued a risk alert on Tuesday about secure use of the OpenClaw AI agent, TechNode reports.

items.title: JobMatchAI-An Intelligent Job Matching Platform Using Knowledge Graphs, Semantic Search and Explainable AI
items.title_zh: JobMatchAI：基于知识图谱、语义搜索与可解释 AI 的智能职位匹配平台
items.summary: JobMatchAI combines Transformer embeddings, a skill knowledge graph and interpretable re-ranking to match candidates and jobs across skill fit, experience, location, salary and company preferences, with factor-wise explanations. It releases the JobSearch-XS benchmark and a hybrid BM25, knowledge-graph and semantic retrieval stack.

items.title: OpenClaw sparks boom as Chinese firms race into the AI agent era
items.title_zh: OpenClaw 引发热潮，中国企业竞相进入 AI 智能体时代
items.summary: The open-source AI agent framework OpenClaw has gone viral worldwide and attracted significant attention from the tech industry, TechNode reports, as Chinese firms race into the AI agent era.
